==What is goArmA==

[[File:goarma_banner.jpg]]


'''"goArmA - launching all the gear"''',<br> 
<br> 
based on customisable startprofiles, is a one-click solution that fulfils almost every desire. A startprofile consists of six modules, which can be combined freely and customised apart as well. Use such profiles for your own, or share them with your clanmates!
----
== VERSION 1.0.42.0 HAS BEEN RELEASED ==

1.0.42.0 (June 02, 2008)

'''Known Issues''':

    * Activation of all single player missions deletes user defined key mappings


1.0.41.0 (April 12, 2007)

'''Known Issues''':

    * [fixed in 1.0.42] Problems with special characters in usernames.
    * [fixed in 1.0.42] Some mods wont get selectable, as the directory structures differs from the standard.
    * [fixed in 1.0.42] Changes within mod directories were not detected.
    * [fixed in 1.0.42] Selected mods were not reset when loading a new profile
    * [fixed in 1.0.42] goArma crashed on selecting a teamspeak server which doesn't have a "ServerWelcomeMessage" set
    * [fixed in 1.0.42] Modfolders containing a "." were not listed correctly
    * [fixed in 1.0.42] ArmA server query problems with newer server versions
    * [fixed in 1.0.42] Mod selection is reset when changing the arma executable.
    * [fixed in 1.0.42] Unable to start beta versions.
    * [added to 1.0.42] New language: Chinese(simple)
    * [added to 1.0.42] New feature: Plugin-Api ('''more intel soon''')

== Features ==
''This featurelist reflects version 1.0.40''<br>
<br>
[[File:goarma_launch.jpg|thumb|right|425px|Splashmode.]]
[[File:goarma_edit.jpg|thumb|right|425px|Editmode.]]
*ArmA-Settings...<br>
::*select almost any known parameter the game can start with, or assign new ones<br>
::*select, delete, add, or open custom-faces in external editors or rather programs<br>
::*select, add, copy to clipboard, delete, or validate squad-xmls with your favourite browser<br>
<br> 
*Gameserver-Settings...<br>
::*create, save, load settings from a generated serverlist<br>
::*fully featured serverquery , disclosing many details<br>
<br> 
*Custom-Sound-Settings...<br>
::*create, save and load sound profiles<br>
::*validate the sounds with external amp or rather mediaplayer<br>
<br> 
*Mod-Settings...<br>
::*show all mods available in the ArmA rootdirectory, that are marked with the well known mod-delimiter @<br>
::*alter files or names by double clicking a single mod (opens explorer for further actions)<br>
<br>
*TeamSpeak-Settings...<br>
::*create, save, or load profiles<br>
::*copy serverdata (adresses, port and stuff) to clipboard<br>
::*serverquery, disclosing many details<br>
::*support for superadmins (send messages, kick or ban users)<br>
<br>
*TeamSpeakOverlay-Settings...<br>
::*customise startparameters<br>
::*show TSO username (further settings available in the global settings menu)<br>
<br>
*More Features...<br>
::*VIeSTA support (not fully tested yet)<br>
::*create your own goArmA skins (almost rudimental, as it is in alpha state)<br>
::*install routine<br>
::*multilingual support (currently DE and EN available)<br>
::*goArmA updates at ease<br>
::*logfilesystem for errorreports<br>
::*readable xml structures to ensure exchange with other tools
::*parameter support:<br>
:::* nosplash (start goArmA in editmode)<br>
:::* noculture (start goArmA in english)<br>
:::* nostyle (support for windowed OS 2000)<br>
:::* autoupdate (force autoupdate check on start)<br>
